verdict.rationale: GitLab documents a public REST API for automating workflows and building integrations. Its OpenAPI 3.0 spec is autogenerated from the API code and published raw in the monorepo, with an interactive tool that shows the curl command for live requests. Auth uses Bearer/OAuth 2.0 tokens, and the API follows semantic versioning with documented deprecations. missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of driving GitLab via the API (only first-party and partner claims are present).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: Automate your workflows and build integrations with the GitLab REST API
GitLab documents its REST API using the OpenAPI 3.0 specification (formerly called Swagger)
Use the interactive request tool to send live requests to GitLab.
GitLab supports authentication with HTTP Bearer or OAuth 2.0 credentials.
GitLab will not make these changes within REST API v4, and follows semantic versioning for the REST API
